planning_notes: Preserve physical wiring: button input uses D4 with pull-up resistor to 5V and button to GND.2; therefore model 'pressed' is true when D4 reads LOW (active_high=false).

The requirement specifies printing exactly: "Button pressed duration: {duration}s". Because serial_channels only support typed numeric/Boolean reports (not fixed text formatting), the SysML model should implement the exact line formatting by printing the required fixed prefix and suffix around the numeric duration when the serial trigger fires.
Bounce handling and duration accumulation (including when to sample/stop and how to convert from elapsed_ms to seconds) belong in the SysML model; control_period_ms is a scheduling granularity only.

A serial_integer_input port is included only as a placeholder for optional external control; it is not required by the provided hardware wiring or success criteria and may be left unused in the model.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Push button pressed (model true when pressed)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Optional external start/stop or command code (not required by wiring; may be unused)

interfaces.name: io_1_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Gate Serial output when the button press duration needs to be reported

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
# Button Duration

## Project Description
This is an Arduino project that determines how long a switch is pressed

## Hardware Components
- Arduino Uno
- 10kΩ resistor
- Push Button

## Circuit Description
Circuit is designed to use a pull-up resistor. When the button is not pressed, the pin4 pin is connected to 5V through a 10kΩ resistor. When the button is pressed, the pin4 pin is connected to gnd2.

## Expected Behavior
When the Arduino powers up, it should:
1. Initialize serial communication
2. Configure the specified button pin as INPUT
3. Continuously monitor the button state and measure how long it is pressed
4. Print the duration in second, in the following format: "Button pressed duration: {duration}s"

## Success Criteria
The test is successful when:
1. The pressed duration in seconds is correctly printed in the given format

## Notes for Implementation
- Include a short delay in the loop to handle switch bouncing
- When the button is not pressed, pin1.l is connected to pin1.r and pin2.l is connected to pin2.r. When the button is pressed, all the pins are connected together.

## Variants
This project may have different variants with the pushbutton connected to different pins.

## Attributes
- To use 10kΩ resistor, set the property name "value" to "10000 ohm".
Given circuit (must preserve wiring):
{
    "version": 1,
    "author": "Blind Author",
    "description": "Manage pull up registor button input",
    "config": {
        "button_pin": 4,
        "gnd_pin": "GND.2"
    },
    "editor": "wokwi",
    "parts": [
        {
            "type": "wokwi-arduino-uno",
            "id": "arduino uno1",
            "top": 0,
            "left": 0,
            "attrs": {}
        },
        {
            "type": "wokwi-pushbutton",
            "id": "push button1",
            "top": -163.8,
            "left": 79.8,
            "rotate": 90,
            "attrs": {
                "color": "green",
                "xray": "1"
            }
        },
        {
            "type": "wokwi-resistor",
            "id": "resistor1",
            "top": -92.05,
            "left": 48,
            "attrs": {
                "value": "10000"
            }
        }
    ],
    "connections": [
        [
            "resistor1:2",
            "push button1:2.r",
            "green",
            [
                "v0"
            ]
        ],
        [
            "resistor1:1",
            "arduino uno1:5V",
            "green",
            [
                "v0"
            ]
        ],
        [
            "push button1:2.l",
            "arduino uno1:4",
            "green",
            [
                "v0"
            ]
        ],
        [
            "push button1:1.r",
            "arduino uno1:GND.2",
            "green",
            [
                "v0"
            ]
        ]
    ],
    "dependencies": {}
}
